title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.60: Sing Along now costs 0 (unchanged on upgrade, was 1/0), and its upgrade adds Retain - encouraging use of a timing-sensitive card and making the timing easier to hit.
